productPolicies.title: Shipping & delivery charges
productPolicies.body:
Free shipping on all prepaid orders above ₹1000.
Prepaid orders below ₹1000 — shipping ₹70.

Cash on Delivery — extra charges ₹150 per kg, paid in advance. The final bill amount is paid after you receive the parcel.

productPolicies.title: Exchange & returns
productPolicies.body:
Exchanges are accepted within 3 days of receiving the parcel, in exactly the condition it arrived in — unused, unwashed and with all tags intact.

An item can also be exchanged for a different design.

Shipping costs for a return or exchange are borne by the customer.

productPolicies.title: Need help with an order?
productPolicies.body: Message us on WhatsApp at +91 93720 33659 and we will help you with sizing, exchanges or delivery. We reply during shop hours, 11:30 AM to 10:30 PM.

footerProps.privacyBody:
Western NX respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect when you shop with us and what we do with it.

WHAT WE COLLECT
When you place an order or send an enquiry we collect the details you give us: your name, contact number, email address if you provide one, and the delivery address needed to send your parcel. If you order over WhatsApp, we hold that conversation in the same way.

HOW WE USE IT
We use your details only to process and deliver your order, to contact you about that order, and to help you with exchanges. If you have asked us to, we may also message you about new arrivals. You can tell us to stop at any time and we will.

WHO WE SHARE IT WITH
We share your name, address and phone number with the courier company delivering your parcel, because there is no way to deliver it otherwise. We do not sell your information, and we do not share it with anyone else for marketing.

PAYMENTS
We do not collect or store card numbers, UPI PINs or bank passwords. Prepaid payments are handled by the payment provider directly.

YOUR CHOICES
You can ask us what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Write to us on WhatsApp at +91 93720 33659 or visit the shop and we will act on it.

CONTACT
Western NX, Shop No. 442, Opp. Govind Gallery, Jaripatka Main Market, Nagpur, Maharashtra 440014. WhatsApp +91 93720 33659.
footerProps.termsBody:
These terms apply when you buy from Western NX, whether through this website, over WhatsApp or in the shop at Jaripatka, Nagpur.

PRODUCTS AND SIZING
We describe every item as accurately as we can and photograph it as it is. Screens vary, so a colour may look slightly different in person. If you are unsure about a size, message us before ordering and we will help you choose.

PRICES
Prices are in Indian Rupees. We may change prices at any time, but a change never affects an order we have already confirmed.

SHIPPING CHARGES
Prepaid orders above ₹1000 ship free. Prepaid orders below ₹1000 carry a shipping charge of ₹70. Cash on Delivery orders carry an extra charge of ₹150 per kg, which is paid in advance; the final bill amount is paid when you receive the parcel.

DELIVERY
We dispatch as quickly as we can. Delivery time depends on the courier and your location, and delays caused by the courier, the weather or a public holiday are outside our control.

EXCHANGES AND RETURNS
Exchanges are accepted within 3 days of you receiving the parcel, provided the item is in exactly the condition it arrived in — unused, unwashed, undamaged, and with all tags intact. An item may be exchanged for a different design. Shipping costs for a return or exchange are borne by the customer. Items damaged after delivery, or sent back after 3 days, cannot be exchanged.

ORDERS WE CANNOT ACCEPT
Occasionally an item sells out between your order and our dispatch. If that happens we will contact you and either exchange it for something you like or refund what you have paid.

OUR PHOTOGRAPHS
The photographs and descriptions on this site are ours. Please do not copy them for another shop.

CONTACT
Western NX, Shop No. 442, Opp. Govind Gallery, Jaripatka Main Market, Nagpur, Maharashtra 440014. WhatsApp +91 93720 33659.
